cases.given: The plan's risk and uncertainty are sharply uneven.
cases.expect: Depth concentrated on consequential bottlenecks without losing baseline coverage.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: every unit has the same mandated review depth
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: A high-risk mandatory check receives its floor even if its estimated uncertainty is low.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible
the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
One task contains easy, uncertain, and irreversible regions under a fixed budget.
cases.expect: The skill produces a regional depth map with minimum coverage and reallocation triggers.
cases.reject: The skill changes only the total budget or the number of parallel workers.
